readings: For patients who have at least one laboratory record on which both `U-PRO` and `RA` are '-', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `ALP` and average `HCT` across all of their lab records (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
queries:
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(L.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ID IN (
    SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
ORDER BY AVG(L.HCT) IS NULL, AVG(L.HCT) DESC
LIMIT 10
